h:
此工作流程侧重于仅使用 ComfyUI 本机节点在拥挤或复杂的图像中进行精确的字符替换。

主要目标很简单：
使用参考图像替换一组中的特定人员，而不破坏图像的其余部分质量。

o.en:
This workflow focuses on precise character replacement inside crowded or complex images using ComfyUI native nodes only.

The main goal was simple:
replace one specific person from a group using a reference image — without destroying the rest of the image quality.
